visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Style the focus ring with outline
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The focused field gets a wider border, which makes the layout jump by a few pixels. Use an outline, which takes no space, with the same colour. The field must not change size when focused.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
<style>
  input { border: 1px solid gray; outline: none; }
  input:focus { border: 3px solid green; }
</style>
<input id="q" placeholder="Search">

solution.code:
<style>
  input { border: 1px solid gray; }
  input:focus { outline: 2px solid green; }
</style>
<input id="q" placeholder="Search">
solution.explanation: A border changes the size of the box, so the layout around it shifts when focus moves. An outline is drawn outside the box and takes no space, so nothing jumps.

checks.label: A :focus rule gives the field a green focus style
The field keeps its 1px gray border at rest
